principle: Research stages use progress and acceptance checkpoints. A task-specific explicit hard resource budget may terminate a command; observer waits do not authorize termination or determine scientific sufficiency.

time_classes.observer_wait: One bounded wait/yield/poll. Preserve job identity and inspect the same operation again. No implicit retry, new job, termination or permission change.
time_classes.progress_checkpoint: Save progress, unresolved work, evidence and next responsibility. Elapsed time does not complete unread sources or accept results.
time_classes.execution_budget: An explicit command budget with a task/resource/external-window reason. Record which time it counts and who can renew it. Existing authority and actual constraints remain in force.
time_classes.evidence_window: Publication, data exposure or historical reconstruction cutoff; not a process stop signal.
time_classes.authorization_expiry: Only an actual authority condition or explicit validity window. A wait/timeout does not grant, widen or silently expire authorization. Changed scope/target/conditions require relevant review.

flags.--checkpoint-seconds: Positive finite progress interval; never ends the child.
flags.--timeout-seconds: Optional positive finite hard job-wall budget. Legacy explicit calls remain supported; a value alone is not scientific calibration.
flags.--time-budget-reason: Task-specific policy basis. Prefer a reason for new calls; legacy explicit calls retain explicit_cli provenance.

runner.outputs: New immutable .running.json entry before launch, append-only .progress.jsonl, stdout/stderr/metrics and final .receipt.json. Existing prefixes are never overwritten.
runner.receipt_publication: Serialize, flush and fsync an owned same-directory temporary file before atomic no-replace publication. A pre-publication storage error cannot leave a final success receipt. This does not claim hardware or filesystem crash durability beyond observed operations.
runner.hard_budget_observation: Recheck elapsed time after observation. If completion is first observed beyond the explicit observation-phase budget, retain root exit code and record operational budget overrun; do not infer a scientific failure or exact unobserved exit time.
runner.time_accounting: Report measured setup, job wall and cleanup separately. External queue/permission-repair time remains unknown. Do not retrospectively subtract costs from frozen budgets.
runner.termination: Only tracked PID plus creation-time identities; the invocation's own Popen root may use its owned handle. No name-based or machine-wide cleanup. AccessDenied stays unknown.
runner.exception_recovery: Interrupts and post-launch exceptions enter cleanup and best-effort terminal recording. If storage is unavailable, retain the prelaunch entry and emit structured stderr recovery information; do not claim durable writes succeeded.
runner.completion: New receipt completion.status must be pass for dependent acceptance. Alive/unknown owned processes and observation gaps stay explicit. Sampled tracking is not OS containment of every short-lived descendant.
runner.resource_authority: Existing memory, thread, path and permission constraints remain. A longer time value grants no other resource or filesystem permission.

environment_probe.configuration: environment.timeout_seconds is positive finite; environment.timeout_basis records the environment/task basis.
environment_probe.meaning: Fixed interpreter/import readiness guard. Required timeout/interruption stays unknown; optional prerequisites retain their own status without blocking unrelated work.
environment_probe.containment_scope: Direct subprocess child only. Arbitrary import-created descendants are not contained; side-effectful readiness work needs an appropriate managed adapter.

git_observation.configuration: Positive finite operational query cap, no uniform maximum.
git_observation.timeout_or_permission: Structured unknown, pending adoption; no active-version write or retry. Another attempt uses a new output path within existing relevant authority.
git_observation.disk_failure: stdout reports error_receipt_written=false if a new error receipt cannot be stored.

dependency_and_acceptance.evidence: Timeout/error/interruption are operational failures; unresolved process observation/cleanup is unknown. Neither is a scientific negative label.
dependency_and_acceptance.task_context: New completion.status other than pass blocks that bound run and its dependent delivery. Resource-loop and research-cycle reuse the bound receipt check.
dependency_and_acceptance.legacy: Historical receipts without completion metadata retain their old interpretation. Preserve benchmark deadlines/results; derived recoveries declare their own budget and lineage.
dependency_and_acceptance.scope: Keep fail/unknown attached to the affected prerequisite. Continue independent authorized work. No new global scheduler or permission grant.

recovery_record_minimum: observed cause and exact denied operation when available
alive, gone and unknown owned processes; cleanup attempts/errors
current authority, budget accounting, next action and responsibility

python -B -m scripts.research_support.run_bounded --cwd WORK --out-prefix NEW_PREFIX --timeout-seconds 7200 --time-budget-reason 'Task-specific compute window' -- COMMAND ARG

validation_scope: Controlled short owned-process fixtures, abnormal-path injection, compatibility and downstream acceptance. No calendar-long reliability, scientific effect or arbitrary containment claim.
